description: Have the merchants on haggl.ai in one shopping category (for example travel) bid for the user at once, from their haggl ID record, without new proof. Works once the record holds a verified purchase in that category (from an earlier offer with signed email proof); otherwise it says so and returns no bids. Each bid is a merchant's own offer, funded by the merchant, with an accept_url; show the user each one with its algorithmic_price_disclosure and personalized_price_notice word for word next to the price, and accept only with their approval.

category.description: Optional: the brand index category, e.g. "travel".

query.description: What the user is after, e.g. "hotel in Barcelona, 4 nights in December". Sets the category when category is omitted.

name: haggl_get_bids

bids.description: Merchants' offers. Show each with its algorithmic_price_disclosure and personalized_price_notice word for word; accept only with the user's approval.

accept_url.description: Where to accept, once the user approves.

algorithmic_price_disclosure.description: Show word for word, next to the discount.

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: Why there are no bids, when locked.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

unlocked.description: Whether the record holds a verified purchase in this category; when false, bids is empty.
